question: Should ClawHub adopt durable private publisher-follow notifications and their authenticated API and data-retention boundary as a supported product capability now?
rationale: The branch adds permanent private relationship and notification data plus a new supported API surface; correctness fixes are mechanical, but accepting and sequencing that product and privacy boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the notification stack
options.body: Approve the boundary, land the follow-graph dependency first, and require the three blockers plus real runtime and upgrade proof before merging this PR.

options.title: Split and defer delivery
options.body: Land only the follow graph and discovery work now, then revisit durable notification storage and fanout in a narrower sponsored PR.

options.title: Decline the capability
options.body: Close the notification stack if permanent in-app follow notifications are outside ClawHub's intended product scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the notification stack
recommendation.body: Approve the boundary, land the follow-graph dependency first, and require the three blockers plus real runtime and upgrade proof before merging this PR.
